profile.name: CCD探测器
profile.description: 用于光谱测量的电荷耦合器件探测器，可将入射光转换为数字信号并输出光谱或图像数据。常见于光谱仪、单色仪或拉曼系统中，支持曝光、增益、读出速度、感兴趣区域、触发和波长相关设置；部分型号可提供EM增益。
profile.description_en: A charge-coupled device detector used for optical measurements, converting incident light into digital spectral or imaging data. It is commonly integrated with spectrometers, monochromators, or Raman systems, and supports configuration of exposure, gain, readout speed, region of interest, triggering, and wavelength-related settings; some models provide EM gain.
